title: Continuous org-wide GitHub to Forgejo, Codeberg, and GitLab mirror with issue and pull request metadata sync
smallest_useful_product: A single Rust binary that discovers every repository in a GitHub organization, creates missing target repositories, mirrors branches and tags, continuously synchronizes issues, labels, milestones and pull request discussions with idempotent mappings and an audit log, and writes a git-tracked JSON archive.
non_goals_v1: Bidirectional review relay except as an explicitly experimental flag
success_measure: Mirror a 50-repository organization with 5,000 issues in under 30 minutes initially and under two minutes incrementally.
